tests.name: Provider List Rendering
tests.description: Verify that all AI providers are displayed correctly in the left sidebar

steps.description: Navigate to Settings page
Click on 'AI' category in left sidebar
Verify all 5 providers are visible: Kimi, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama

tests.expected_result: All 5 AI providers are displayed with correct icons, names, and descriptions

tests.name: Provider Selection
tests.description: Test selecting different providers from the list

steps.description: Click on DeepSeek provider in the list
Verify DeepSeek configuration panel is displayed
Click on Kimi provider in the list
Verify Kimi configuration panel is displayed with Kimi-specific integration section

tests.expected_result: Clicking provider switches to its configuration panel with correct content

tests.name: Provider Enable/Disable Toggle
tests.description: Test enabling and disabling a provider

steps.description: Select Kimi provider
Click the enable toggle in the provider config header
Verify provider status indicator turns green
Click the toggle again to disable
Verify provider status indicator turns gray

tests.expected_result: Toggle switches provider on/off with visual feedback in status indicator

tests.name: API Configuration Input
tests.description: Test entering API endpoint and key

steps.description: Select DeepSeek provider
Enter API endpoint URL
Enter API key
Verify both inputs display entered values

tests.expected_result: Endpoint and API key inputs accept and display text correctly

tests.name: Provider Search Filter
tests.description: Test filtering providers by search query

steps.description: Type 'deep' in provider search box
Verify only DeepSeek is visible in the list
Clear the search box
Verify all providers are visible again

tests.expected_result: Search filters providers by name and description, clearing restores full list

tests.name: Test Connection Button

steps.description: Select DeepSeek provider
Enter an invalid API key
Click Test Connection button
Verify error status message is displayed in red

tests.expected_result: Test connection shows appropriate error message for invalid credentials

tests.name: Fetch Models Button

steps.description: Select Kimi provider
Click Fetch Models button
Verify loading indicator is shown
Verify models are displayed or error message shown

tests.expected_result: Fetch models triggers API call and displays results or error

tests.name: Model Enable/Disable
tests.description: Test enabling and disabling individual models

steps.description: Select Kimi provider
Verify models section is visible with model list
Click toggle for first model
Verify enabled count badge updates correctly

tests.expected_result: Toggling model updates its enabled state and reflects in the count badge

tests.name: Model Search Filter
tests.description: Test filtering models by search query

steps.description: Select Kimi provider
Type 'k2' in model search box
Verify only models matching 'k2' are displayed

tests.expected_result: Model search filters the list by model name and ID

tests.name: Settings Save

steps.description: Select Kimi provider
Click Save Settings button
Verify success message is displayed in green

tests.expected_result: Save button persists settings and shows success confirmation
